authenticity_review: Image demonstrates high photorealistic fidelity: individual fur strands on monkey, feather texture on penguin, natural wood-chip ground with consistent lighting/shadows. However, two minor artifacts reduce authenticity slightly: (1) Monkey’s right hand (viewer’s left) exhibits digit fusion — fingers lack clear separation and knuckle definition, appearing as a soft mass rather than discrete digits. Animal pose auditor flagged 29% low-confidence keypoints in hind limbs (including hands/feet region), corroborating structural uncertainty. (2) Subtle texture bleeding at the contact zone between monkey’s white chest fur and penguin’s black back — while possibly attributable to shallow depth-of-field, the transition lacks the sharp edge expected from real occlusion boundaries. These are severity-1 issues per checklist guidelines; they do not dominate but warrant a modest deduction. Overall authenticity remains strong but not flawless.
